about_me.title: About Me
about_me.paragraph: I started almost two and a half years ago in web development, specializing in Frontend with React and its ecosystem, interested in creating attractive and functional interfaces that improve the user experience. My curiosity for the Backend led me to explore Node, experimenting with Express and deepening in Nest to develop more robust and scalable solutions.
about_me.sub_paragraph: From Buenos Aires, Argentina, I am constantly learning, facing new challenges, exploring new technologies and best practices to keep improving as a developer. Below, I show you some of the technologies I use on a daily basis.
